title: ONYX canonical translation catalog
description: Validates the flat, two-segment ONYX translation catalogs. New keys must use lowerCamelCase leaves. common.total_items is a single grandfathered Phase 1 syntax exception.

propertyNames.description: Keys must be exactly two segments: a ratified namespace plus a lowerCamelCase leaf. common.total_items is the single grandfathered exception.

common.total_items.description: Grandfathered Phase 1 syntax exception for one unresolved call-site key.
